summary: Beazer Homes USA Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger with Dream Finders Homes, Inc. (Parent) and its wholly owned subsidiary, Bulldogs Merger Sub, Inc. Under the terms, each Beazer share will be converted into the right to receive $33.50 per share in cash. Beazer's board unanimously approved the deal and recommends stockholders adopt the merger agreement. Stock options will be cashed out based on the excess of the merger consideration over exercise price. The merger is subject to stockholder approval, regulatory clearances, and other customary conditions. The transaction implies a value for Beazer's equity and will result in Beazer continuing as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. What to watch: stockholder vote timing, regulatory review, and any competing bids.
